title: Quarter-Wave Initialized 12-Layer Stack with Localized Perturbation Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses near quarter-wave optical thickness for the 8-13 μm band center (~10.5 μm) and applying small-step localized perturbation will converge to higher target scores than the previous broad-range gradient search, as fine-scale interference tuning becomes more effective once candidates enter the valid regime.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack provides physically motivated starting point; localized perturbation exploits interference fine-tuning without escaping the valid basin identified in iteration_01.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2 | SiO2] x6 | Si substrate (12 finite layers total, alternating sequence fixed)
design_variables: layer thicknesses (12 variables, initialized 250-550 nm range)
manufacturing_considerations: thickness range 250-550 nm compatible with deposition control
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for Bragg reflector/emitter design
Localized optimization converges faster near valid basin
expected_advantages: Faster convergence than broad gradient search
Better exploitation of interference effects identified in iteration_01
known_risks: May converge to local optimum near initialization
Quarter-wave assumption may not be optimal for dual-band selectivity
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer HfO2/SiO2 multilayer stack on silicon substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: alternating HfO2/SiO2 starting with HfO2 (6 pairs, 12 finite layers). Initialize all layer thicknesses uniformly distributed between 250-550 nm. Use localized perturbation optimizer with reduced step size (learning rate 0.01-0.05) for fine-scale thickness tuning. Target: maximize absorptance/emissivity in 8000-13000 nm band, minimize emissivity in 3000-5000 nm band. Normal incidence, unpolarized or average of TE/TM. Evaluate candidates via TMM. Do not reproduce thickness arrays matching excluded fingerprints: 5730cdc3d0a12ddf, d672da543a029796, 5dcb880065e6b552, 6f233010bd58d5ec, 3e3543b14e3f2172, d69f71359c410182, 5df8a77d62a82442, 90d74c952ccb7c62. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Iteration_01 achieved 0.8903 target score with 12L candidates; feedback directive specifies quarter-wave initialization (250-550 nm) and localized perturbation strategy to exploit fine-scale interference tuning. This route implements that exact change while avoiding previously tested stack fingerprints.
